description: This file defines the PassthroughEndpointRouter class, which manages credentials for pass-through endpoints, including setting, retrieving, and managing environment variables, as well as handling vertex AI credentials and vector store credentials.

classes.name: PassthroughEndpointRouter
classes.description: Handles credentials management for pass-through endpoints, including setting/getting credentials, environment configuration, and integration with Vertex AI and vector store registry.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the credentials dictionaries and default configuration.

methods.name: set_pass_through_credentials( self, custom_llm_provider: str, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Sets credentials for a pass-through endpoint with specified provider, API base, and API key.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_credentials( self, custom_llm_provider: str, region_name: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Retrieves stored credentials for a given provider and region, or fetches from environment if not found.

methods.name: VertexPassThroughCredentials _get_vertex_env_vars(self)
methods.description: Gather vertex pass-through credentials from environment variables.

methods.name: set_default_vertex_config(self, config: Optional[dict] = None)
methods.description: Sets the default vertex configuration, optionally from a provided dictionary or environment.

methods.name: add_vertex_credentials( self, project_id: str, location: str, vertex_credentials: Optional[VERTEX_CREDENTIALS_TYPES], )
methods.description: Adds vertex credentials for a specific project ID and location.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_deployment_key( self, project_id: Optional[str], location: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Generates a deployment key based on project ID and location.

methods.name: Optional[LiteLLM_ManagedVectorStore] get_vector_store_credentials( self, vector_store_id: str )
methods.description: Retrieves vector store credentials for a specified vector store ID.

methods.name: Optional[VertexPassThroughCredentials] get_vertex_credentials( self, project_id: Optional[str], location: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Fetches vertex credentials for a specific project ID and location, or returns the default configuration.

methods.name: str _get_credential_name_for_provider( self, custom_llm_provider: str, region_name: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Generates a credential name based on provider and region.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_region_name_from_api_base( self, custom_llm_provider: str, api_base: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Infers region name from API base URL specific to provider.

methods.name: str _get_default_env_variable_name_passthrough_endpoint( custom_llm_provider: str, )
methods.description: Returns environment variable name pattern for pass-through endpoint credentials.
